commit.message:
docs: refresh README with verified content and current version

- Bumped Installation section version pin from 26.6.0.0 to 26.7.0.0, matching
  the currently published package.
- Restored a header font-color line in the first Quick Start example that was
  missing relative to the real, current example this library ships.
- Added a Product Links section pointing at the open-source and commercial
  product pages.
- Rewrote the API Reference intro sentence to state the real public-type count
  and module grouping as a plain fact, removing internal generation-process
  framing ("mirrors reference.aspose.org's own class index") that was never
  meant for a public README.
- Added a Documentation & Resources section linking the real docs/kb/reference
  pages for this product/platform.
- Verified every code example's imports and named API members against the
  current published source; verified format-support claims against the
  library's real formats data with independent source corroboration.

Verification: every claim checked against the library's real, current source
(not the prior README's own text); the At-a-Glance diagram, Key Capabilities,
and API Reference table were independently verified for accuracy and internal
consistency before this refresh.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
